author: Epicraft321
body: On February 14, 2015 I was banned from the avicus network. I was banned for excessive infractions. I admit, I provoked the situation and caused those problems with those mods. Yes it was me. A little while after I gave up video games(Not because I got banned though. I just thought it was a little repetitive) and during those months I matured a bit more and took real life understanding to what mods deal with. I want to make my comeback on the server I started on. I fully understand if you don't trust my words and feel like I should remain banned, all I'm asking for is 1 last chance. I deserved what I received, and the mods did their job. Thank you for taking your time to read this.
